name: BOIM Korean Business Directory
description: Hosted read-only MCP server for finding businesses in Korea: 2.7M businesses across all industries by region and industry, 75,000+ public-procurement vendor cards from Public Procurement Service data, and open public bids (KONEPS, Defense e-Procurement, LH, K-water, Nuri-jangteo). No authentication for the free tier, which returns up to 5 results per tool plus a link to the full public web list; full results need a BOIM API key.
author: Public identity Co., Ltd.
